spans.s: गो—बक m. the bird Ardea Govina, W.
गो॑—बन्धु (गो॑-), mfn. (= -मातृ) having a cow as a relative (the Maruts), RV. viii, 20, 8.
गो—बल॑ m. N. of a man, TBr. iii, 11, 9, 3.
गो—बलीवर्द-न्यायेन instr. ind. after the manner of ‘a bull of cattle’, an expression to denote when a pleonasm is allowed, Nāg. on Pat. Introd. Mn. viii, 28, Sch.
गो—बल्लव m. a cowherd, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 66, Kāś.
गो—बीज-काञ्चन n. pl. cows (and) grain (and) gold, Mn. viii, 88
गो—ब्राह्मण n. sg. a cow and (or) a Brāhman, Mn. v, 95 and xi, 80; MBh. xiii;
गो—ब्राह्मण—मनुष्य m. pl. cows, Brāhmans, and men, W.
